items.title: StyleSmuggler: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (RCE) in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This critical zero-day vulnerability, dubbed StyleSmuggler, allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution on affected Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source installations. It abuses Magento's template-processing functionality to inject and execute malicious PHP code and has been actively exploited in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source (Hotfix for CVE-2026-75650)
items.summary: This emergency security bulletin addresses a critical vulnerability (CVE-2026-75650) that could result in arbitrary code execution. Adobe is aware of active exploitation of this vulnerability in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, which could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for the issues addressed in this specific bulletin.

items.title: Adobe patches critical Magento account takeover
items.summary: Adobe released APSB26-92 as isolated patch files, fixing seven vulnerabilities, including an unauthenticated customer account takeover with a CVSS score of 9.1.
